name: paper-espresso
description: Turn one research paper into a compact, source-checked learning artifact with editable LaTeX and a compiled, layout-checked PDF.

interface.longDescription: Creates a compact one- or few-page learning artifact that preserves a paper's central idea, mechanism, essential mathematics, evidence, assumptions, and limits.
defaultPrompt: $paper-espresso ./paper.pdf — two A4 pages; emphasize the proof strategy.
